item.title: Agent harness - Why do we need it?
item.description: For a moment, imagine all you have is a Large Language Model (LLM) with no chat window. All you are allowed to do is send a REST API call or the client SDK a model provider offers. When you do this, the model receives the text input and generates text output. It can generate text, but it cannot act. It can think and reason, but it cannot read from or write to your local files. Then it forgets everything it ever received and its response, and waits to be called again. This isn’t enough if you want to achieve anything useful with an LLM. This is where an agent harness comes into play. The agent harness is what makes it observe, remember, and act.
